reason: A regression evaluation harness for DSH plugins and skills that runs YAML-defined cases against real headless agents, asserts session traces and outputs, compares baselines, and produces CI gate results.

summaries.zh: 用于为 DSH 插件和技能运行 YAML 用例回归评测、检查会话轨迹与输出、对比基线并生成 CI 门禁结果。
summaries.en: Runs YAML-defined regression evaluations for DSH plugins and skills, checks session traces and outputs, compares baselines, and produces CI gate results.

capabilities: Runs headless DSH agent subprocesses for evaluation cases
Reads and parses session trace files, including zstd-compressed traces
Writes evaluation reports and baseline comparison results
Can call an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API for optional semantic judging
Returns CI-oriented pass, warn, fail, and exit-code results
